title: GitHub transforms into 3D city with buildings based on commits #github #vibecoding #webdev
description: Someone transformed GitHub into a 3D city where every developer is represented as a building. The height and size of each building correspond to the number of commits and developer activity, creating a visual, interactive map of contributions. Created using vibe code within just four days, this project showcases how AI-assisted coding is changing software development. Instead of writing every line manually, developers now guide the creation process while AI handles much of the workload, enabling rapid and innovative project builds. This novel visualization not only gamifies coding activity but also provides a unique perspective on developer engagement, highlighting potential for future tools in software collaboration and productivity. #GitHubCity #VibeCode #DeveloperVisualization #AIcoding #SoftwareInnovation #GitHubProjects #CodingProductivity #CloudCode #VSCode #TechInnovation #DeveloperTools #3DCoding #AIinProgramming #SoftwareDevelopment #CodingVisualization
